title: With Aquino at the AFIO meeting in Las Vegas

tellings.quote: So, he says, "We're going to go to Vegas. Las Vegas is having a meeting of the Association of Former Intelligence Officers,

plain: The writer Peter Levenda, billed on the episode as a historian of the CIA, says he was taken to Las Vegas for a meeting of the Association of Former Intelligence Officers, a group of retired spies, where he was with a man named Michael Aquino. He tells it as something he took part in, and also names a man called John B. Alexander. In his telling, someone said to him: "We're going to go to Vegas. Las Vegas is having a meeting of the Association of Former Intelligence Officers."
